nodes.label: Planned Automation UI fixed allow-list of server-defined actions
nodes.norm_label: planned automation ui fixed allow-list of server-defined actions
nodes.rationale: Server-validated actions (e.g. switch relay N on) instead of free-form commands, to keep shell execution unreachable from the frontend.

nodes.label: Port list fallback to rc file ports
nodes.norm_label: port list fallback to rc file ports
nodes.rationale: Keeps the fake controller and manually listed ports selectable when serial port detection fails.

nodes.label: Security rule: shell commands
nodes.rationale: taskrunner runs shell commands; its only input must stay the rc-file events list. Never pass socket/HTTP/frontend input to taskRunner.run(); never add an API that writes events or anything later handed to run(); only config value Kinetiq writes is secret.

nodes.label: Kinetiq CNC backend (src/server/cnc)
nodes.rationale: CNCjs GRBL server code carried into Kinetiq so Kinetiq no longer depends on ../CNCJS-fork; folder layout mirrors CNCjs so relative imports are unchanged; Kinetiq changes are marked with // Kinetiq: or // SECURITY (Kinetiq): comments.

nodes.label: Not carried over: Express app, REST API, i18n, views, Marlin/Smoothie/TinyG, CNCjs CLI
nodes.norm_label: not carried over: express app, rest api, i18n, views, marlin/smoothie/tinyg, cncjs cli

nodes.label: Files stay JavaScript (allowJs in tsconfig.server.json)
nodes.rationale: Keeps logic line-for-line what ran under CNCjs.

nodes.label: GrblController.setExclusive(on)
nodes.rationale: While exclusive, query timer sends no ?/$G and Feeder lines are dropped (Feeder reset); real-time bytes via write() (Hold, Reset) still go out; turning off clears query masks. Used by settings editor XModem upload.

nodes.label: M6 manual tool-change pause
nodes.rationale: tool:change routine, tool.* config, TOOL_CHANGE_POLICY_* and lasertest:on/off removed 2026-11-08; M6 is sent as comment (M6) and the job pauses until Resume (CNCjs default policy, no longer configurable).
